ad_text:
Lumo Systems Oy is hiring a backend developer!
We are a young and dynamic team of 14 in Otaniemi, Espoo, building the booking platform Finnish tradespeople rely on.

You will fit right in if you have:
- fluent Finnish (our customers call in Finnish)
- Master's degree required in Computer Science or similar
- solid Python experience and a habit of automated testing
- no unexplained gaps in your CV

The real problem waiting for you: our CI pipeline takes 40 minutes for every merge and it is eating the team's day. In your first 90 days you make it fast again.
Photo on the CV appreciated. Apply now!

card.title: Backend developer — make our CI fast again
card.problem_90d: Our CI pipeline takes 40 minutes for every merge. Releases slip and senior developers burn review time waiting on builds.

must_haves.text: Has made a slow build or CI pipeline measurably faster
must_haves.how_we_check: Walk us through one pipeline you sped up — what you changed and the before/after numbers
must_haves.esco_label: use continuous integration and delivery tools

must_haves.how_we_check: Show and explain a Python service you wrote yourself

must_haves.text: Writes automated tests as part of daily work
must_haves.how_we_check: Describe a test that caught a real bug before release

nice_to_haves: A fit for our young and dynamic team
card.work_mode: hybrid — Otaniemi office, 2 days on site

followups: Is Finnish needed for customer calls or only internal chat — and by when?
Which pipeline is the slow one — build, test or deploy?
Is the Master's degree about a specific skill we should name instead?
